title: When Posting All Your Crimes to Snapchat Comes Back to Haunt You
description:
► Code Blue Cam Merch 
http://www.codebluecam.com/

On August 21, 2023, a deputy attempted to stop a vehicle for equipment violations, but the male driver fled at high speeds in Westfield, WI. After leading deputies on a reckless pursuit, he was apprehended as a passenger in another vehicle during a high-risk traffic stop.

The suspect, known to deputies for his social media posts, frequently shared images of himself smoking marijuana and wielding firearms while making derogatory comments about law enforcement. He also sought advice on obtaining and selling large quantities of marijuana. Later on, the deputy shared some words of wisdom with the male, while also revealing how he was aware of every detail about him, leaving him visibly stunned.

Our featured content aims to depict law enforcement interactions, emphasizing education over public shaming or ridicule. In a world filled with misleading conversations about law enforcement, it's crucial to present these interactions within their contexts to inform and educate the public.
